protocol: Sensor Controller (Tracker) frame: A5 AA | DEST-ID | CMD-ID | PAYLOAD-LEN | PAYLOAD | BA
description: Avionics sensor controller. Owns board power control and SSD (boot device) selection for the Payload Server (PS) and Edge Server (ES), and reports board temperatures and power state. No checksum in the frame: SOF, the length byte and EOF are the only integrity signals.

messages.name: TC_SET_POWER_CTRL_PS_ES_BRD
messages.doc_reference: TC SET sheet row 1 — Command ID 128, Dest ID 50
messages.description: Power the Payload Server or Edge Server board ON, OFF, or restart it. avn_set_board_power_control_req_t.

messages.name: TC_SET_PS_ES_SSD_SELECTION
messages.doc_reference: TC SET sheet row 2 — Command ID 129, Dest ID 50
messages.description: Select which SSD the Payload Server or Edge Server board boots from. avn_set_board_ssd_selection_req_t.

messages.name: TC_GET_TEMPERATURE_SENSOR_DATA
messages.doc_reference: TC GET sheet row 1 — Command ID 1, Dest ID 50
messages.description: Request the temperature of one hardware instance. avn_get_board_temperature_req_t.

messages.name: TC_GET_SSD_SELC
messages.doc_reference: TC GET sheet row 2 — Command ID 4, Dest ID 50
messages.description: Read back which SSD a board is currently selected to boot from. avn_get_board_ssd_selection_req_t.

messages.name: TC_GET_BOARD_PWR_CTRL_STS
messages.doc_reference: TC GET sheet row 3 — Command ID 7, Dest ID 50, 'NO Structure (CMD-ID Follows)'
messages.description: Request the power state of all four boards. Carries no payload — the command id alone is the request.

messages.name: TC_SET_POWER_CTRL_PS_ES_BRD_RSP
messages.description: Response to board power control. A NACK instead carries (error_event, error_byte) — see FrameErrorEvent.

messages.name: TC_SET_PS_ES_SSD_SELECTION_RSP
messages.description: Response to SSD selection. A NACK instead carries (error_event, error_byte) — see FrameErrorEvent.

messages.name: TC_GET_TEMPERATURE_SENSOR_DATA_RSP
messages.description: Board temperature. temp_value is BIG-endian, unlike every other subsystem in this MIB: temperature = ((MSB << 8) | LSB) / 100.0, interpreted as int16_t. Deliberately carries no 'scale': the codec divides by scale on decode while the CLI multiplies by it, so any scaled field is off by scale-squared (see the EPS temperature readings). The field therefore decodes as the honest raw count in units of 0.01 degC.

parameters.name: temp_value
parameters.description: Signed 16-bit, big-endian. Divide by 100 for degrees Celsius: 2534 = +25.34 degC, -1025 = -10.25 degC

messages.name: TC_GET_SSD_SELC_RSP
messages.description: Which SSD the addressed board is selected to boot from.

messages.name: TC_GET_BOARD_PWR_CTRL_STS_RSP
messages.description: Power state of all four boards. Note these four instances are not addressable individually by the board_type field of command 128, which offers only PS and ES.

messages.name: TC_SET_POWER_CTRL_PS_ES_BRD_NACK
messages.doc_reference: FRAME_FORMAT_ENUMS sheet — NACK frame carries ERROR EVENT then ERROR BYTE
messages.description: Negative acknowledgement of TC_SET_POWER_CTRL_PS_ES_BRD. Same cmd_id as the ACK; told apart by payload length.

parameters.name: error_byte
parameters.description: Context byte — the simulator returns the rejected cmd_id

messages.name: TC_GET_SSD_SELC_NACK
messages.doc_reference: FRAME_FORMAT_ENUMS sheet — NACK frame carries ERROR EVENT then ERROR BYTE
messages.description: Negative acknowledgement of TC_GET_SSD_SELC. Same cmd_id as the ACK; told apart by payload length. AMBIGUOUS: this command's ACK payload is also 2 bytes, so a NACK cannot be told apart from a success by length alone — it decodes as the ACK. Needs a flag bit or a distinct reply id from the firmware.

parameters.name: error_byte
parameters.description: Context byte — the simulator returns the rejected cmd_id
